finalText: Build now exits 0. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined bare variable `retries` instead of reading it from the `env` argument passed in (`resolveConfig({ cacheSize: 512, retries: 3 })`), throwing a `ReferenceError` that aborted the link stage. Fixed it to `env.retries || 3`. The three `WARN` lines in the log (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are pre-existing warnings, not related to the failure — build now completes with those same 3 warnings and 0 errors.
